name: The Spot at Oakdale Yacht
aliases: The Spot at Oakdale Yacht Club

evidence.note: Official site describes a lively dockside tiki bar with weekly live music where people come for dancing the night away.
Sat Oct 3: First Annual Oktoberfest with Rich Mahogany, 3-7 pm, no cover, heated tents.
Marina guest review mentions a tiki bar restaurant with live music almost every night.

dancing.notes: The venue invites guests to dance the night away at its dockside band shows. On Oct 3 it holds an Oktoberfest afternoon with heated tents and a band.

description: An outdoor tiki bar and restaurant on the docks of the Oakdale Yacht marina, with a band stage, waterfront seating and live music most weekends in season.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's 'Oaksale' is a typo for Oakdale. The Spot sits at the Oakdale Yacht marina (Oakdale Yacht Club); Ira's List has pages /oakdale-yacht-club and /yacht-club-mondays-oakdale-yacht for it. Bing lists 500 Shore Dr; the official site says 520 Shore Dr. Ira gave no time; the venue lists 3-7 pm. No official Facebook URL confirmed. Kind could also be 'marina-club'.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Facebook is now confirmed: the venue's own site links facebook.com/thespotoyc (and Instagram @thespotoyc). County (Suffolk) follows from the Oakdale 11769 address (Town of Islip). Hours are seasonal and not on the venue's site; aggregators list Fri 4 PM-12 AM and Sat-Sun 12 PM-12 AM, closed Mon-Thu, but that was not recorded. No public email (the contact form only). The dance photo shows an adult crowd under the tent; please check before use if you prefer photos without recognizable faces. Some photo file names on the site look like old Facebook uploads, but they are hosted on the venue's own Squarespace site.
